title: Increase conditional kappa to 0.00302152 with changed warp maps and Lean certificates
body:
Jointly changing native warp maps and scalar-contact frames gives **conditional
kappa = 37769/12500000 = 0.00302152**, improving PR4535's 0.003020165 by
**0.000001355**. The selected repository frontier remains unchanged.

The frozen construction changes 34 native G maps and 422 scalar frame labels,
preserving every original scalar opcode, external interface and all 408
arbitrary productive helpers. Its paid profile changes from
`2237 H1 + 388 H2 + 494 H3 + 147 H4 + 36 H5 + 8 H8` to
`2201 H1 + 412 H2 + 506 H3 + 135 H4 + 36 H5 + 8 H8`.
This removes 12 recursive calls locally and 216 across the retained 18-call
p16 controller. All query, idle and completion charges remain included.

The profile difference is `12(3 H1 - 2 H2 - H3 + H4)`, a strict moment
improvement for every `0<t<1`. Executable exact interval arithmetic brackets
the new raw crossing in `(0.0030215551,0.0030215552)`; the claimed saving leaves
explicit compiler and outer-inequality slack.

The seven-gate Python replay regenerates the frozen word without a solver,
checks both retained native interpreters on all 632 arbitrary persistent
inputs in both orientations, checks absolute phases for 34 changed operators,
180 used warp classes and 128 new paid pairs, proves the uniform gain, replays
retained dependencies, rebuilds complete pricing and runs an independent AI
audit. Unchanged physical recipes retain source-bound coverage.

The Lean additions have explicit scopes:

- `AnalyticGain.lean` proves the exact local and 18-fold real-power profile gain.
- `NumericalMoments.lean` proves complete-profile contraction and both charged
  tail inequalities at the tested saving **0.00302153**. This tested value is
  distinct from the smaller claimed kappa.
- `CompilerCapacity.lean` proves the real-power capacity and initial-range
  bounds. `ArithmeticCertificate.lean` proves **54 strict and 4 functional
  outer checks**, exact source-formula/value equalities, and closed compiler
  integer inequalities.
- The native modules cover 4429 binary bases, 72 invertible maps, 2863 paid
  classes, 180 signed warp classes, both 21449-event frame/contact traces,
  productive-helper interfaces, paid censuses and scalar tariffs.
- `KappaWarpVerification.lean` binds native censuses to the numerical profiles,
  adds the literal retained controller bills, aligns rational/real parameters
  and combines the scoped results.

All **23 Lean modules passed**. The final `LEAN-VERIFICATION.json` binds frozen inputs, exact generated sources, command/log/compiled-output hashes, complete coefficient bindings and **45 exported axiom reports**. All seven executable gates also passed in the focused publication checkout.

Lean is pinned to **4.21.0**, mathlib to
`308445d7985027f538e281e18df29ca16ede2ba3`. The checked exports
use only `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`; no admitted statements
or custom axioms are used. See the Lean package README for setup and replay:

```sh
python3.14 -B research/kappa-interface-round2-20261022/verify_result.py
python3.14 -B research/kappa-lean-verification-20261022/generate_arithmetic.py
python3.14 -B research/kappa-lean-verification-20261022/verify_lean.py
```

JSON/hash transcription, native amplitudes/absolute phases, free-group endpoint
semantics, controller/compiler transfer and inherited tape, precision, stock,
matching and recovery contracts remain explicit boundaries. This is a
conditional construction with scoped Lean certificates, not a complete Lean
integer-multiplication theorem. The enormous uniform template is not
materialized; no practical speedup or independent human review is claimed.

Built against `f626db5c3a3d781d8f7695038776c621651f75e1`. Credit Cinna Davis's
[PR4470 supplier](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4470),
Dugongue, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and cumulative predecessor sources.
Comparison: [PR4535](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4535),
head `a6d7237f697185e857090e174c23c1cb22c6563c`.
Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0; inherited notices preserved.

Open next questions: formalize the finite Clifford phase semantics and the 632-column symbolic endpoint identity, then connect these certificates to the inherited compiler transfer. See `research/kappa-lean-verification-20261022/README.md` for the smallest follow-ups and remaining boundaries.

Signed: Cao Yifan
